subject: Structured bundle proposal — retention, tracing & dashboards
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@acme.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.io>
Date: 2028-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — can we consolidate pricing?

Thanks for the call this morning, Jordan. Quick summary and asks from our side: we run inference-heavy workloads and are considering Redwood for Hosted + Add-ons (trace retention and advanced dashboards). Two commercial asks: 1) a single bundle price vs itemized add-ons, and 2) a predictable overage mechanism for retention spikes.

We tried to map your back-of-envelope numbers to our runway and came up with a target price of ~$75k ARR for the bundle during year one (pilot scale), with a path to expansion to $300k ARR if we commit to a 12-month runway. Is there room to structure a pilot-friendly package with credits and a graduated discount on expansion?

Please attach a consolidated quote and a short note on how trace egress/long-term retention gets billed in spikes.

Cheers,
Maya
CTO, Acme Robotics

--
Attachment: Acme_requirements_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@acme.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-05T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Structured bundle proposal — retention, tracing & dashboards

Maya — thanks for the clear ask and for the time today. I attached a short bundle proposal (PDF) that combines: 1) retention (30-day searchable retention by default, upgradeable to 90/365), 2) tracing (ingestion + long-term archive), and 3) advanced dashboard seats. Highlights:

- Pilot bundle (Q2): $75k ARR equivalent in credits covering up to 75M retention tokens/month, 500GB trace ingest, and 3 advanced dashboard seats. Pilot includes $10k POC credits for tracing spikes.
- Year-1 expansion tier (12-month commit): $300k ARR for 300M tokens/month, 2TB trace ingest, 10 seats; baseline 10% discount on list if committed annually.
- Overage: usage billed monthly; retention overage billed at $0.06 per 1k tokens for the pilot (tiered to $0.04 at expansion). Trace egress billed by GB at published rates; archival storage billed at $0.01/GB-month.
- Concessions we can offer: an additional one-time 12% discount on the expansion tier if Acme signs within 30 days and agrees to an NRE deposit (applies to product credits, not to egress).

I put the detailed numbers in the attached PDF and flagged the parts where we can be flexible. If you want, we can schedule a short commercial call tomorrow to walk through the delta between your $75k target and the expansion path.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Rep — Redwood Inference
Attachment: 2028-04-05_REDWOOD_bundle_pricing_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-05T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Structured bundle proposal — retention, tracing & dashboards

Jordan — notes from reviewing the numbers. I marked actionable items below so we can be fast on a concession path: 

1) Pilot parity: the $75k pilot offer lines up, but the $10k POC credit for tracing spikes should be extended to cover first-month overages from onboarding (common). Recommend we increase POC credit to $15k and mark as refundable against first invoice.

2) Overage clarity: external teams hate per-token uncertainty. Suggest we offer a graded overage cap for pilots: cap monthly overages at 25% of pilot list price (so Acme has a max spend expectation). For expansion, keep tiered per-1k token price but add a quarterly reconciliation that can convert overage into committed capacity discounts.

3) Discount structure: rather than a flat 12% acceleration, propose a two-step concession: sign within 30 days -> extra 8% discount; agree to a 12-month ramp/commit schedule -> incremental 4% on top (total up to 12%). That gives them a clear path while saving room.

4) Dashboard seats: offer first 3 seats free for 90 days; after that, $450/seat/mo.

If Acme pushes back, having the refundable $15k credit + a hard overage cap will usually move the needle. I can join the commercial call.

—Marissa
Director, Commercials
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Singh <maya@acme.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.io>
Date: 2028-04-06T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Structured bundle proposal — retention, tracing & dashboards

Thanks Jordan — the PDF is helpful. A few clarifying items from our CFO: 1) the pilot needs a hard cap on spend, not just credits; 2) we prefer a monthly bill that’s predictable in the pilot (so credits = cap rather than an estimate); 3) any refundable deposit needs to offset start-up costs, not be a penalty.

If you can confirm: refundable $15k credit applied as first invoice credit; pilot hard cap = $75k (no monthly surprise beyond that cap); and 90-day dashboard seats free, then we can get contracting started. We are not ready to commit to 12 months yet — expansion decision at pilot completion.

Can you confirm those three items and send a redline-ready SOW/PO template?

Maya

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-07T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Structured bundle proposal — retention, tracing & dashboards

Maya — really appreciate the clarity here. We can confirm the three items and will reflect them in the SOW:

1) Pilot hard cap: $75,000 total for the pilot period. Any usage beyond pilot cap will not be charged without prior written agreement.
2) Refundable credit: $15,000 refundable credit will be posted; it will be applied to the first invoice and otherwise returned per the SOW terms.
3) Dashboard seats: first 3 advanced seats free for 90 days.

I'll attach a redline-ready SOW (Acme_PO_template.docx) and a short commercial summary that maps pilot usage bands to expansion pricing. Two quick notes: the pilot cap means we will throttle long-retention archival jobs if they risk pushing you over the cap without notice — we will run alerts and coordinate. Also, our standard egress billing policy still applies for external egress (we can add an egress waiver for the pilot if needed).

If that all looks good, Jordan and I can move to contracting and legal—eta for SOW is end of day tomorrow.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Acme_PO_template.docx (PO template stub); commercial_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
